d:
Bihar ki siyasat men aanand mohan aur anant sinh ek bar phir charcha men hain. donon netaon ke jel jane ke bad rajnitik galiyaron men kaee saval uth rahe hain. aakhir aanand mohan aur anant sinh se siyasi chuk kahan huee? unke jel jane ka bihar ki rajniti par kya asar par sakta hai? kya in ghatnaon ne unke rajnitik samikarnon ko prabhavit kiya hai? dekhie is khas vishleshan men.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
